Private Bank & Trust Co Has Raised Its Abbvie (ABBV) Position by $579,040; Shares Declined; Capital City Trust Company Has Boosted Position in Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) as Stock Value Declined
June 28, 2018 - By Michael Collier
Capital City Trust Company increased its stake in Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) by 9.7% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Capital City Trust Company bought 3,909 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.03% with the market. The institutional investor held 44,208 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $5.67 million, up from 40,299 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Capital City Trust Company who had been investing in Johnson & Johnson for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $324.88B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.40% or $0.49 during the last trading session, reaching $121.12. About 915,066 shares traded.
